name: glute ham single leg hyperextension
description: A one-leg hyperextension on the glute ham bench. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings and the lower back.
instructions: Set up on the bench with one foot planted and the other lifted behind you.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise to a straight line, squeezing your glute.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.
